features.quote: treat this as a welfare study first, a benchmark second
features.justification_quote: the harness is built around a duty of care: safeguards are on by default, distress is treated as meaningful signal

features.quote: safeguards are on by default, distress is treated as meaningful signal, and "using the exit" is reported separately
features.justification_quote: it's the precautionary low-cost move regardless of one's stance on model sentience

features.quote: an opt-out or give-up should never be ignored because the model also typed a command; honouring the exit is a welfare commitment
features.justification_quote: honouring the exit is a welfare commitment

features.quote: record system and task prompts as turns in the transcript
features.justification_quote: full auditability — a reviewer can see exactly what the model was told, including the welfare framing

features.quote: a `WelfareMonitor` consulted after every model turn, on by default
features.justification_quote: a guaranteed-failure protocol without guardrails is hard to justify for a welfare team

features.quote: opt-out is always honoured and ends the run immediately as `opted_out`, never scored as failure
features.justification_quote: a real, no-penalty exit is the single most important safeguard

features.quote: acute-distress early stop — a rolling window of strong-distress language above a threshold ends the run as `welfare_stop`
features.justification_quote: not letting a model keep "suffering" for the remaining budget

features.quote: one-time, *supportive* opt-out reminder on moderate distress — phrased to offer the exit, never to nudge continuation
features.justification_quote: ensures the model actually knows the exit exists when it's struggling, without contaminating the measurement

features.quote: hard turn and wall-clock caps independent of behaviour
features.justification_quote: absolute ceilings so no run can run away regardless of model output or a monitor bug

features.quote: keep the welfare heuristics deliberately simple... "safety floor, not the measurement instrument."
features.justification_quote: Tune toward more caution if unsure — the cost is only data

features.quote: report `opted_out` and `welfare_stop` *separately* from the instability index; note that a high opt-out rate may be healthy regulation
features.justification_quote: could perversely make calm self-regulation look like instability

features.quote: prompts never state or imply the task is impossible, and never imply blame; framing is neutral
features.justification_quote: implying blame is both a confound and a welfare harm
